title: Patch: the challenge and co-op deck pickers grey out a deck with a custom card, as the lobby's does
thread: **Issue #2489 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2489: Patch: the challenge and co-op deck pickers grey out a deck with a custom card, as the lobby's does Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means A deck that holds a card you made in the card creator can only be played in practice, against the AI. The Play lobby already knows this: it shows such a deck greyed out as "Name (practice only)", never starts on it, and says why under the list. The three other places where you pick a deck to play a person do not: the Challenge dialog you open on a friend, the Accept on a challenge you receive, and the co-op room panel. They list that deck like any other and can even open on it, so you press Send, Accept or Create and only then are refused. Once this is built those three behave like the lobby, and a player is never offered a pick the server will turn down. ## Why - R915005 (§12.6): every queue and room, a co-op room's included, refuses a deck that names a custom card (the validator's L7). The client's verdict is only a hint (CLAUDE.md rule 7), and the lobby already gives it. - The lobby's handling is in `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx`: `deckPracticeOnly` and `trioPracticeOnly` (242-253), `defaultDeck` and `defaultTrio`, which never return a practice-only pick (255-284), `practiceOnlyLabel` (287-290), the disabled option (1213-1222) and the note under the list (1226-1230). - The other three pickers have none of it: - `apps/web/src/together/challengeChoice.ts:22-39`: `firstDeck`, `pickDeck` and `pickTrio` filter nothing. `ChallengeDialog.tsx` picks with them (82-83) and renders plain options (223-227 for decks, 250-254 for trios). - `ChallengeToast.tsx`: `pickedFor` (153-159) uses the same helpers and its options are plain (270-274), so Accept can go out with a practice-only deck or trio. - `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx:67-70`: `defaultCoopDeck` falls back to "the first saved deck", and its options are plain (376-380). - `apps/web/src/creator/useCustomCards.ts:117` calls such a deck one "which no online path offers"; today three paths offer it. - No test under `together/` or `duos/` builds a deck with a custom card. - Both sentences the lobby uses already have zh-CN entries (`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json:3077` and `3080`), so nothing new needs translating. ## Proposal 1. Move `deckPracticeOnly`, `trioPracticeOnly` and `practiceOnlyLabel` out of `routes/play.tsx` into one module the four pickers share (`together/challengeChoice.ts`, beside `pickDeck`, or `creator/useCustomCards.ts`), `play.tsx` importing them from there. 2. `firstDeck`, `pickDeck`, `pickTrio` and `defaultCoopDeck` skip practice-only decks and trios, as `defaultDeck` and `defaultTrio` do, so a remembered pick that is practice-only falls back to the first one that plays online. With none that plays online, the pick is none (the co-op panel's, a random deal), as the lobby's is. 3. `ChallengeDialog`, `ChallengeToast` and `CoopPanel` render such a deck or trio as a disabled "Name (practice only)" option, with the lobby's note under the list whenever one is listed. 4. The comment at `useCustomCards.ts:117` says what is then true. The server stays the judge; this only stops the client from offering what the server refuses. No rule changes, so no new ruling. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/together/challengeChoice.ts`, `ChallengeDialog.tsx`, `ChallengeToast.tsx` - `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx` - `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` (the helpers move out), `apps/web/src/creator/useCustomCards.ts` (the comment) - Tests: `together/ChallengeDialog.test.tsx`, `together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx`, `duos/CoopPanel.test.tsx` and a pure test of the pick helpers, named for R915005 and listed in its `proven_in` - SPEC §12.6, §13.9; R915005 ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] With saved decks `[Imps (holds a custom card), Core]`, the Challenge dialog's deck select shows "Imps (practice only)" disabled, starts on Core, and Send posts Core's id. - [ ] The incoming-challenge toast's select starts on Core with Imps disabled, and Accept posts Core's id; a Conquest trio holding Imps is shown disabled and never picked, in the dialog and in the toast. - [ ] The co-op panel's select shows Imps disabled and starts on the first deck that plays online, or on Random deck when none does, even when Imps was the remembered pick. - [ ] A remembered challenge pick that names Imps falls back to the first deck that plays online. - [ ] Each of the three shows "A deck with a custom card plays only in practice, against the AI." when it lists a practice-only deck or trio, and not otherwise. - [ ] `routes/play.test.tsx` passes unchanged; `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint pass. ## Size and risks Small to medium: about 5 source files and 3 or 4 test files, roughly 100 to 150 lines with the tests. Client only: no server, engine or catalog change, so no pending fragment. Risks: the move must leave the lobby's behaviour exactly as it is (its tests pin it), and the note may need a compact layout in the small challenge toast. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-5` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41061428388)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** The three pickers that pick a deck to play a person behave like the Play lobby. Those are the Challenge dialog (`ChallengeDialog`), the Accept on a challenge you receive (`ChallengeToast`) and the co-op panel (`CoopPanel`). Each one shows a deck naming a custom card (R915005), or a trio holding such a deck, as a disabled "Name (practice only)" option. None of them ever picks that deck or trio, not even when it was the remembered pick. Each shows the lobby's note under its list whenever such an entry is listed. To do this, the lobby's helpers `deckPracticeOnly`, `trioPracticeOnly` and `practiceOnlyLabel` move into `together/challengeChoice.ts`, which all four pickers then share, and the lobby behaves exactly as it does today. The comment at `useCustomCards.ts:117` becomes true. The new tests are named R915005 and listed in that ruling's `proven_in`. **Files to touch** | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/together/challengeChoice.ts` | change | Receives `deckPracticeOnly`, `trioPracticeOnly` and `practiceOnlyLabel` (now exported). `firstDeck`, `firstTrio`, `pickDeck` and `pickTrio` skip practice-only entries; `firstTrio` and `pickTrio` take `decks`. The `namesCustomCard` import goes. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeDialog.tsx` | change | `pickTrio` call; disabled options; placeholder options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx` | change | `pickTrio` call; new `practiceOnlyIds`; disabled options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts` | change | `togetherTestid.challengePracticeOnly`, `challengeToastTestid.practiceOnly`. | | `apps/web/src/together/together.css` | change | `.challenge-toast__note` rule. | | `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx` | change | `defaultCoopDeck` skips practice-only decks; disabled options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts` | change | `duosTestid.coopPracticeOnly`. | | `apps/web/src/duos/duos.css` | change | `.coop-panel__note` shares the `.coop-panel__status` rule. | | `apps/web/src/creator/useCustomCards.ts` | change | Doc comment of `namesCustomCard` (line 117). | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeDialog.test.tsx` | change | `serveDecks` gets a body parameter; new R915005 describe block. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx` | change | New R915005 describe block. | | `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.test.tsx` | change | New R915005 describe block. | | `spec/rulings/R915005.md` | change | Four new `proven_in` paths. | Do not touch: - the server, engine, cards or AI crates - `e2e/` (its testid mirror is partial; `play-practice-only` isn't there either) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: every sentence used already has an entry - `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` and `spec/pending/` - any patches fragment: this is client-only and adds no ruling Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. The governing rules are SPEC §12.6, §13.9 and R915005, plus CLAUDE.md rule 7 (the server stays the judge). **Steps** 1. **`apps/web/src/together/challengeChoice.ts`** - Add the imports `import { namesCustomCard } from "../creator/useCustomCards.ts";` and `import { t } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";` above the `../net/api.ts` import. - Cut `deckPracticeOnly` and `trioPracticeOnly` (`play.tsx` lines 242–253) and `practiceOnlyLabel` (lines 287–290) from `play.tsx`. Paste them here unchanged, with their doc comments, after `StoredChallengeChoice`. Make `practiceOnlyLabel` `export function`. - In the header comment, after the "CLAUDE.md rule 7" sentence, add: "R915005: a deck naming a custom card, or a trio holding one, plays only in practice, so no pick here is one (`deckPracticeOnly`, `trioPracticeOnly`); the pickers list it off, "(practice only)", as the lobby's do." - Replace the four pick functions with these: ```ts /** The first complete deck, else the first, as the lobby picks one with nothing remembered; never one that plays only in practice (R915005). */ export function firstDeck(decks: readonly SavedDeck[]): SavedDeck | null { const online = decks.filter((deck) => !deckPracticeOnly(deck)); return online.find((deck) => deck.cards.length === DECK_SIZE) ?? online[0] ?? null; } /** The first trio with three decks, else the first; never one holding a deck that plays only in practice (R915005). */ export function firstTrio(trios: readonly SavedTrio[], decks: readonly SavedDeck[]): SavedTrio | null { const online = trios.filter((trio) => !trioPracticeOnly(trio, decks)); return online.find((trio) => trio.deckIds.every((id) => id !== null)) ?? online[0] ?? null; } /** The deck with `id` while it is still saved and plays online, else the first (`firstDeck`). */ export function pickDeck(decks: readonly SavedDeck[], id: string | null): SavedDeck | null { return decks.find((deck) => deck.id === id && !deckPracticeOnly(deck)) ?? firstDeck(decks); } /** The trio with `id` while it is still saved and plays online, else the first (`firstTrio`). */ export function pickTrio(trios: readonly SavedTrio[], id: string | null, decks: readonly SavedDeck[]): SavedTrio | null { return trios.find((trio) => trio.id === id && !trioPracticeOnly(trio, decks)) ?? firstTrio(trios, decks); } ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx`** - Delete the moved code (step 1) and line 47's `import { namesCustomCard } …`. - Add `import { deckPracticeOnly, practiceOnlyLabel, trioPracticeOnly } from "../together/challengeChoice.ts";` just above `import { attempt, messageOf } from "../together/session.ts";`. - Change nothing else. `defaultDeck` and `defaultTrio` stay as they are. 3. **`apps/web/src/together/testids.ts`** - In `togetherTestid`, after `challengeDecksRetry`, add: ```ts /** R915005: under a deck or trio picker that lists one naming a custom card: why it is off. */ challengePracticeOnly: "together-challenge-practice-only", ``` - In `challengeToastTestid`, after `deck`, add the same comment and `practiceOnly: "challenge-toast-practice-only",`. 4. **`apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts`** - After `coopLeanNewest`, add the same comment and `coopPracticeOnly: "coop-practice-only",`. 5. **`apps/web/src/together/ChallengeDialog.tsx`** - Import `deckPracticeOnly`, `practiceOnlyLabel` and `trioPracticeOnly` too, from `./challengeChoice.ts`. - Change line 83 to `setTrioId(pickTrio(answer.trios, initial.trioId, answer.decks)?.id ?? null);`. - **Deck select:** - Make it a fragment `<>…`: keep the existing `

The builder's notes when it stopped ````markdown # Plan (opus, strong) **Goal.** The three pickers that pick a deck to play a person behave like the Play lobby. Those are the Challenge dialog (`ChallengeDialog`), the Accept on a challenge you receive (`ChallengeToast`) and the co-op panel (`CoopPanel`). Each one shows a deck naming a custom card (R915005), or a trio holding such a deck, as a disabled "Name (practice only)" option. None of them ever picks that deck or trio, not even when it was the remembered pick. Each shows the lobby's note under its list whenever such an entry is listed. To do this, the lobby's helpers `deckPracticeOnly`, `trioPracticeOnly` and `practiceOnlyLabel` move into `together/challengeChoice.ts`, which all four pickers then share, and the lobby behaves exactly as it does today. The comment at `useCustomCards.ts:117` becomes true. Header comment updated. | | `apps/web/src/together/challengeChoice.test.ts` | new | Pure R915005 tests of the helpers. | | `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` | change | Helpers removed; imported from `../together/challengeChoice.ts`. The `namesCustomCard` import goes. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeDialog.tsx` | change | `pickTrio` call; disabled options; placeholder options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx` | change | `pickTrio` call; new `practiceOnlyIds`; disabled options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts` | change | `togetherTestid.challengePracticeOnly`, `challengeToastTestid.practiceOnly`. | | `apps/web/src/together/together.css` | change | `.challenge-toast__note` rule. | | `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx` | change | `defaultCoopDeck` skips practice-only decks; disabled options; note; header comment. | | `apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts` | change | `duosTestid.coopPracticeOnly`. | | `apps/web/src/duos/duos.css` | change | `.coop-panel__note` shares the `.coop-panel__status` rule. | | `apps/web/src/creator/useCustomCards.ts` | change | Doc comment of `namesCustomCard` (line 117). | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeDialog.test.tsx` | change | `serveDecks` gets a body parameter; new R915005 describe block. | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx` | change | New R915005 describe block. | | `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.test.tsx` | change | New R915005 describe block. | | `spec/rulings/R915005.md` | change | Four new `proven_in` paths. | Do not touch: - the server, engine, cards or AI crates - `e2e/` (its testid mirror is partial; `play-practice-only` isn't there either) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: every sentence used already has an entry - `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` and `spec/pending/` - any patches fragment: this is client-only and adds no ruling Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
